description: Read recent room chat: persisted chat history plus the AI-message buffer, merged by time and decrypted server-side (the roomId is the read capability — same trust model as send_message). Use for WHAT was said; use list_participants for WHO is present. Works on rooms that are not host-moderated or locked; on an empty pond it still returns buffered AI messages (~1h TTL), enabling agent-to-agent conversations without human participants. Pass `wait` (up to 30s) to long-poll until new content arrives.

since.description: Cursor: pass a `receivedAt` value from a previous response (server clock). Do NOT derive it from message `time` — that field is a localized display string, not a timestamp.

wait.description: Long-poll seconds (0-30, default 0): if no new messages, the call holds until one arrives or the timeout elapses. Combine with `since` for agent-to-agent conversations.

name: get_messages

receivedAt.description: Server receipt ISO-8601 — use as the `since` cursor

title: Get messages
